scientific.integrity: The practical two-state ASGD recurrence is specialized exactly to one scalar quadratic mode. Its trace and determinant are computed algebraically, the complete second-order Jury criterion gives the exact stability interval, and the source parameter constraint yields a sharp global lower envelope.
limitations: Fixed source parameters over the trajectory.
Stability classification rather than stochastic-risk or optimal-rate analysis.
The deterministic endpoint overlaps classical Nesterov context; the claimed contribution is the full statistical-advantage stability frontier.

title: ASGD has a sharp statistical-advantage stability crossover
